A '''Bith''' lived in a [[Unidentified Ragmar V settlement|settlement of outcasts]] around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the final [[Time/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The Bith took part in a [[Battle of Ragmar V|fight]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ragmar V]] that was against the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone armies]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The battle was originally planned to be set against a detachment of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]], [[Joc Sah]]. The fight took a different turn however when the clone troopers were ordered to execute [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]; a directive that labeled all Jedi as traitors to the Republic and that they were to be executed immediately. The settlement leader, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Gaan]], made peace with Joc Sah, and together with the other settlers repelled the clone troopers, with the having Bith taken a place on a roof with [[Unidentified Rodian outcast|three]] [[Unidentified red-headed Human female outcast|other]] [[Unidentified Klatooinian outcast 1|outcasts]] for the fight.<ref name="TOO" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|Take 'em out!|A Klatooinian gives the order to fire on Remy|<ref name="TOO" />}}
[[File:Ragmar_V_Standoff.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Bith prepares to fire on the clone troopers]]
A [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] criminal lived in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], during the final year of an intergalactic conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around or before this time, the Bith joined up with a [[Unidentified Ragmar V settlement|settlement of pariahs and outcasts]] that existed on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ragmar V]]. The settlement was led by a [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Gaan]], and was seconded by a [[Unidentified Klatooinian outcast 1|Klatooinian]]. During the Bith's stay, the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|armies]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], under the leadership of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Sev (Jedi)|Jedi]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|padawan]] [[Joc Sah]], arrived on Ragmar V to build an outpost that would be used as a staging ground against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Republic's opposition in the Clone Wars. Gaan detested the Republic for his own reasons, and ordered a Republic [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] to be destroyed when it landed on a mesa near the settlement. The gunship's occupants, Joc Sah and his detachment of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], survived, however, and began to make their way to the settlement. Predicting a fight, Gaan ordered the Bith, the Klatooinian, a [[Unidentified Rodian outcast|Rodian]], and a [[Unidentified red-headed Human female outcast|Human female]] to the rooftops while he would confront the Jedi in the street, noting that he wanted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Jedi personally.<ref name="TOO" />

The Bith followed orders, arming up with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], but while Gaan met Joc Sah in the street, [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]] [[Remy (clone trooper)|Remy]] received the command to execute [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]&mdash;an order from the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] that branded all Jedi as traitors to be executed immediately. Sah managed to escape the follow up [[Battle of Ragmar V|attack]] from his own men, but Gaan had mistaken the clone trooper's [[Lightfight|fire]] for the settler's, firing without his command. When informed that it was in fact the clones who had turned on the Jedi, Gaan angrily killed a clone trooper before taking cover with Sah from the return fire. The Klatooinian, still situated on the rooftops, took matters into his own hands and ordered the settlers to fire. The Bith and the others followed through, and eliminated the clone troopers. After the initial fighting was over, the settlers having only lost the Rodian, the Bith made his way down the street to regroup with the other outcasts as Joc Sah accepted the fact that he was now one of them. The Bith then began to make preparations with the other settlers to fight off a second, larger, wave of clone troopers who would be arriving to ensure Sah's elimination.<ref name="TOO" /> After engaging the clone troopers, Gaan and Sah escaped the settlement and proceeded to manage a number of hit and run attacks on the pursuing clone troopers.<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|III|123|Sah, Joc}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
The Bith was a hardy individual, and was prepared to go against the odds, ready to fight both a Jedi and his clone troopers, and much later go up against an entire army of clone troopers. The Bith was enthusiastic, along with the other outcasts, when offered the chance to fight the clone troopers. The Bith disliked the Republic for his own reasons, strengthening his want to fight the Republic. The Bith had [[Color/Legends|pink]] skin and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TOO" />

==Equipment==
The Bith armed up with a silver blaster for the fight against Remy's clone troopers, and used it again during the second fight with the larger [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] force. The Bith also wore a [[Bandolier/Legends|bandolier]].<ref name="TOO" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bith was created for the short story ''[[The Order of Outcasts]]'', which was one of four stories compiled into the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 5|fifth volume]] of the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (graphic novels)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] [[Star Wars comic books|trade paperback]] series. ''The Order of Outcasts'' was written by [[Matt Jacobs]], and was illustrated by [[Matthew Fillbach|Matthew]] and [[Shawn Fillbach]]. So far the character has not received a name, like many of the characters from the story.<ref name="TOO" />
